reasoning: Action logging is clearly implemented twice: core/audit_log.py records structured JSON-line events per day with kinds including tool_call/permission/security_block/mcp_call, and security/audit_logger.py records every sandbox execution attempt with risk, backend, command hash and denial reason. The day-sharded file layout and date-bounded load_events give the structure a retention policy would operate on, but no pruning/expiry code appears in the shown files, so that half of the ticket is not directly visible.

evidence.why: Appends one bounded JSON audit event per action into day-sharded .jsonl files, never raising.
Reads audit events filtered by start/end date and kind, the date-window machinery retention would rely on.
Persists an AuditEntry for every sandbox execution attempt (allow/deny/execute) with risk score, backend and denial reason.
Aggregates mirrored audit events across machines, confirming the audit log is a real cross-machine store.
